description: This file, ec_util.h, contains utility functions, class definitions, enums, and includes related to the EasyConnect protocol, DPP (Device Provisioning Protocol), and wireless frame manipulation. It provides mechanisms for handling Wi-Fi attributes, encoding/decoding DPP information, managing security context, and more.
external_files: // Assumed for JSON handling based on decode/encode functions
external_methods: Different methods related to JSON encoding/decoding from cJSON

classes.name: ec_util
classes.description: A utility class providing static functions for handling Wi-Fi frame attributes, DPP URI encoding/decoding, security contexts, and various helper functions related to the EasyConnect protocol.

methods.name: init_frame
methods.description: Initializes an EC frame with default WFA parameters.

methods.name: get_attrib
methods.description: Retrieves a host-byte-ordered attribute from a buffer based on attribute ID.

methods.name: uint8_t * add_attrib(uint8_t * buff,size_t * buff_len,ec_attrib_id_t id,std::string str)
methods.description: Adds an attribute to a buffer, reallocating if necessary, with various overloads for different data types.

methods.name: ec_frame_t * alloc_frame(ec_frame_type_t type)
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new EC frame with a specified type.

methods.name: std::pair<void *,size_t> alloc_gas_frame(dpp_gas_action_type_t action,uint8_t dialog_token)
methods.description: Allocates a GAS frame based on the specified action type and initializes common fields.

methods.name: copy_attrs_to_frame
methods.description: Copies attributes into a frame, reallocating if necessary.

methods.name: bool validate_frame(const ec_frame_t * frame,ec_frame_type_t type)
methods.description: Validates a frame's correctness and checks its type if provided.

methods.name: parse_dpp_chirp_tlv
methods.description: Parses a DPP Chirp Value TLV to extract MAC and hash.

methods.name: create_dpp_chirp_tlv
methods.description: Creates and allocates a DPP Chirp Value TLV with optional MAC and hash.

methods.name: parse_encap_dpp_tlv
methods.description: Parses an Encap DPP TLV to extract destination MAC, frame type, and encapsulated frame.

methods.name: create_encap_dpp_tlv
methods.description: Creates and allocates an Encap DPP TLV with specified parameters.

methods.name: freq_to_channel_attr
methods.description: Converts a frequency to a standardized WFA channel attribute format.

methods.name: generate_channel_list
methods.description: Generates a formatted channel list string based on scanned channels.

methods.name: check_caps_compatible
methods.description: Checks if the capabilities of initiator and responder are compatible.

methods.name: std::vector<std::pair<uint32_t,uint32_t>> parse_dpp_uri_channel_list(std::string class_channel_str)
methods.description: Decodes a DPP URI channel-list string into op-class and channel pairs.

methods.name: encode_bootstrap_data_json
methods.description: Encodes DPP bootstrap data into a JSON string.

methods.name: encode_bootstrap_data_uri
methods.description: Encodes DPP bootstrap data into a URI string.

methods.name: decode_bootstrap_data_uri
methods.description: Decodes a DPP URI into bootstrap data.

methods.name: decode_bootstrap_data_json
methods.description: Decodes a JSON object into bootstrap data.

methods.name: read_bootstrap_data_from_files
methods.description: Reads bootstrap data from specified JSON and PEM files.

methods.name: write_bootstrap_data_to_files
methods.description: Writes bootstrap data to files, including PEM private key.

methods.name: generate_dpp_boot_data
methods.description: Generates DPP bootstrapping data with optional channel info.

methods.name: get_dpp_boot_data
methods.description: Fetches DPP bootstrapping data, either generating new or reading from file.

methods.name: write_persistent_sec_ctx
methods.description: Writes persistent security context data to a folder.

methods.name: read_persistent_sec_ctx
methods.description: Reads persistent security context data from a folder.

methods.name: generate_sec_ctx_keys
methods.description: Generates new security context keys.

methods.name: generate_dpp_connector
methods.description: Generates a DPP connector string from security context and network role.

methods.name: bool interruptible_sleep(std::chrono::steady_clock::duration duration,std::function<bool ()> stop_on,std::chrono::milliseconds polling_interval=std::chrono::milliseconds (100))
